description: NCBI GenBank nucleotide record search (nuccore): accession with version, title, sequence length, organism, molecule type and last update date. Metadata only, no sequence. Accepts an accession (e.g. NM_000546), a gene or any NCBI search term. Up to 10 records per call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

term.description: Accession or search term, letters, digits, spaces, brackets, dots, hyphens, 2 to 100 characters
